float4 GetAmbient(float3 i_Norm) 				 { 				 float3 norm = i_Norm * i_Norm; 				 float3 isNegative = i_Norm < 0; 				 float4 ambi = 	norm.x * cAmbientCube[isNegative.x] + 								norm.y * cAmbientCube[isNegative.y + 2] + 								norm.z * cAmbientCube[isNegative.z + 4]; 				 return ambi; 				 } 				 float4 GetFog(float3 i_Eye2Vec) 				 { 				 float2 dir = i_Eye2Vec.xz; 				 float2 dir_power = dir * dir; 				 float2 isNegative = dir < 0; 				 float4 fogcol = 	dir_power.x * cFogDirColor4[isNegative.x] + 									dir_power.y * cFogDirColor4[isNegative.y + 2]; 				 return lerp(   fogcol, cFogColor, abs( dot(i_Eye2Vec,float3(0,-1,0)) )    ); 				 }
